difficulty.rationale_zh: 基礎副詞修飾動詞（carefully review），句構單純直接。

items.prompt_en: All department heads must ____ review the updated travel reimbursement guidelines before Friday.

evidence.quote_en: must ____ review the updated travel reimbursement guidelines

items.explanation_zh: 助動詞 must 與及物動詞原形 review 之間需填入副詞以修飾動作「仔細地審閱」，故選副詞 (B) carefully。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: careful 為形容詞，不可直接修飾一般動詞 review。
carefulness 為名詞，無法置於助動詞與本動詞之間作狀語。
caring 為現在分詞／形容詞「體貼的、關懷的」，詞性與語意皆不符。

vocabulary.note_zh: travel reimbursement 指差旅費報銷。

provenance.rights_note_zh: 全原創命題與虛構商務情境，未使用任何 ETS 官方試題、劍橋或第三方受版權保護之教材與商標。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 基礎連接詞與介系詞辨析（because of + 名詞片語 vs 子句連接詞）。

items.prompt_en: The orientation workshop was moved to the main auditorium ____ the unexpectedly high number of registrants.

evidence.quote_en: ____ the unexpectedly high number of registrants

items.explanation_zh: 空格後 the unexpectedly high number of registrants 為純名詞片語而非完整子句，且語意表達「由於報名人數出乎意料地多」，故應選複合介系詞 (C) due to。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: because 為從屬連接詞，後方須接具動詞之完整子句。
although 為讓步從屬連接詞，後方須接子句且語意矛盾。
so that 引導目的狀語子句，後方不能只接名詞片語。

vocabulary.note_zh: 大型會議或培訓場地。
workshop registrants 指研習營報名人員。

provenance.rights_note_zh: 全原創命題與虛構商務情境，未使用任何 ETS 官方試題、劍橋或第三方受版權保護之教材與商標。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 被動語態與過去簡單式時間標記（last night）搭配。

items.prompt_en: Two faulty conveyor motors ____ by the night-shift maintenance crew before production resumed at dawn.

evidence.quote_en: Two faulty conveyor motors ____ by the night-shift maintenance crew before production resumed

items.explanation_zh: 主詞 Two faulty conveyor motors（兩具故障的輸送帶馬達）為承受動作之物，且由 by the night-shift maintenance crew 及從屬子句過去式 resumed 可知應使用過去簡單被動語態 (B) were replaced。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: replaced 為主動語態，馬達無法自行更換。
have replaced 為現在完成主動語態，語態與過去時間點 before production resumed 均不合。
replacing 為分詞，缺少助動詞無法作為主要子句限定動詞。

vocabulary.note_zh: 生產線常見設備。
production resumed 指產線恢復運轉。

provenance.rights_note_zh: 全原創命題與虛構商務情境，未使用任何 ETS 官方試題、劍橋或第三方受版權保護之教材與商標。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 反身代名詞強調用法（review the ledger herself）。

items.prompt_en: Ms. Lindqvist decided to audit the third-quarter expense ledger ____ rather than delegating the task to an intern.

evidence.quote_en: Ms. Lindqvist decided to audit the third-quarter expense ledger ____ rather than delegating

items.explanation_zh: 此處結構已完整（audit the third-quarter expense ledger），空格用於強調主詞 Ms. Lindqvist「親自」查核帳冊而非交辦實習生，故選反身代名詞 (D) herself。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: she 為主格代名詞，不可置於受詞後作同位強調。
her 為受格或所有格形容詞，此處無被修飾名詞亦非動詞受詞。
hers 為所有格代名詞（= her ledger），不符「親自查核」之狀語強調結構。

vocabulary.note_zh: expense ledger 指費用分類帳。
delegate a task to someone 指將任務交辦某人。

provenance.rights_note_zh: 全原創命題與虛構商務情境，未使用任何 ETS 官方試題、劍橋或第三方受版權保護之教材與商標。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 商務動詞詞義與受詞（unauthorized access）精準搭配。

items.prompt_en: Installing multi-factor authentication on all remote laptops will help ____ unauthorized access to client databases.

evidence.quote_en: help ____ unauthorized access to client databases

items.explanation_zh: 啟用多重身分驗證的目的在於「防止、阻止」未經授權存取客戶資料庫，prevent unauthorized access 為標準資安商務搭配，故選 (A) prevent。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: persuade 意為「說服」，受詞通常為人，與 unauthorized access 不搭配。
postpone 意為「延後（會議或期限）」，資安防護旨在防止而非僅延後非法存取。
prescribe 意為「開立處方、規定」，與阻止非法存取語意不合。

vocabulary.note_zh: multi-factor authentication (MFA) 指多重身分驗證。

provenance.rights_note_zh: 全原創命題與虛構商務情境，未使用任何 ETS 官方試題、劍橋或第三方受版權保護之教材與商標。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 條件連接詞 provided that（只要、在…條件下）與未來出貨承諾搭配。

items.prompt_en: Vanguard Freight can guarantee next-day delivery to regional warehouses ____ the purchase order is submitted before 2:00 P.M.

evidence.quote_en: can guarantee next-day delivery to regional warehouses ____ the purchase order is submitted before 2:00 P.M.

items.explanation_zh: 主句「保證隔日送達」以從屬子句「採購單於下午兩點前送出」為必要前提條件，(A) provided that（只要、在…條件下）連接完整條件子句且語意精確。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: even though 表讓步「儘管」，與前後因果條件關係相反。
as if 表「彷彿、好像」，不適用於合約或物流交期條件。
in case of 為複合介系詞，後方只能接名詞片語，不能接完整子句 the purchase order is submitted。

vocabulary.note_zh: regional warehouse 指區域倉庫。

provenance.rights_note_zh: 全原創命題與虛構商務情境，未使用任何 ETS 官方試題、劍橋或第三方受版權保護之教材與商標。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 關係代名詞所有格 whose 修飾先行詞（start-up companies whose products...）。

items.prompt_en: The innovation showcase will feature twelve start-up companies ____ products reduce commercial packaging waste.

evidence.quote_en: twelve start-up companies ____ products reduce commercial packaging waste

items.explanation_zh: 先行詞為 twelve start-up companies，空格後緊接無冠詞名詞 products 並作關係子句主詞（products reduce...），表示「這些新創公司的產品」，須用所有格關係代名詞 (C) whose。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: which 在關係子句中作主格或受格，不能直接修飾後方名詞 products。
whom 為受格關係代名詞，不可作所有格修飾語。
what 為複合關係代名詞，前方不可有先行詞 start-up companies。

vocabulary.note_zh: innovation showcase 指創新發表展。

provenance.rights_note_zh: 全原創命題與虛構商務情境，未使用任何 ETS 官方試題、劍橋或第三方受版權保護之教材與商標。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 形容詞詞義辨析（eligible for a full refund 符合全額退費資格）。

items.prompt_en: Customers who return unopened electronics within fourteen days of purchase are ____ for a full refund.

evidence.quote_en: are ____ for a full refund

items.explanation_zh: be eligible for + 名詞 為標準商務慣用搭配，意為「符合…的資格、有資格獲得…」，故選 (A) eligible。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: probable 意為「很可能發生的」，主詞通常為事件而非人（Customers），且不搭配 for a refund。
accessible 意為「可進入的、可取得的」，常搭配 to，主詞應為設施或資訊而非顧客。
reliant 意為「依賴的」，搭配介系詞 on/upon 而非 for。

vocabulary.note_zh: 退貨條件常見用語。
be eligible for 意為「有資格享有…」。

provenance.rights_note_zh: 全原創命題與虛構商務情境，未使用任何 ETS 官方試題、劍橋或第三方受版權保護之教材與商標。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 未來完成式（will have occupied）搭配 by the end of next month 時間界線。

items.prompt_en: By the time the annex renovation concludes in November, Sterling Law Partners ____ the fourth-floor suite for ten years.

evidence.quote_en: By the time the annex renovation concludes in November, Sterling Law Partners ____ the fourth-floor suite for ten years

items.explanation_zh: 句首 By the time + 現在式表未來時間點（concludes in November），搭配持續時間段 for ten years，主句須用未來完成式表示「屆時將已承租滿十年」，故選 (C) will have occupied。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: occupies 為現在簡單式，無法表達截至未來特定時間點累積滿十年之完成狀態。
occupied 為過去簡單式，與未來時間點 in November 衝突。
is occupying 為現在進行式，不與 for ten years 及未來完成時間點搭配。

vocabulary.note_zh: 辦公大樓常見設施詞彙。
fourth-floor suite 指四樓辦公套房。

provenance.rights_note_zh: 全原創命題與虛構商務情境，未使用任何 ETS 官方試題、劍橋或第三方受版權保護之教材與商標。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 名詞衍生詞與複合名詞結構區辨（confidentiality agreement 保密協議 vs 形容詞 confidential）。

items.prompt_en: All external consultants are required to sign a ____ agreement before reviewing proprietary engineering blueprints.

evidence.quote_en: sign a ____ agreement before reviewing proprietary engineering blueprints

items.explanation_zh: 「保密協議」的標準法務固定複合名詞為 confidentiality agreement（以抽象名詞 confidentiality 作定語說明協議性質），選項中並無 confidential，故選 (D) confidentiality。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: confide 為動詞「吐露、信賴」，不可直接修飾名詞 agreement。
confident 為形容詞「有自信的」，與「機密／保密」語意完全不同。
confidentially 為副詞「私下地、機密地」，不可修飾名詞 agreement。

vocabulary.note_zh: proprietary blueprints 指公司專有工程藍圖。

provenance.rights_note_zh: 全原創命題與虛構商務情境，未使用任何 ETS 官方試題、劍橋或第三方受版權保護之教材與商標。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 讓步介系詞 notwithstanding 與句意轉折（儘管原物料價格波動，仍維持固定報價）。

items.prompt_en: ____ recent fluctuations in global aluminum prices, Kestrel Components will honor its quoted unit rates through December.

evidence.quote_en: ____ recent fluctuations in global aluminum prices, Kestrel Components will honor its quoted unit rates

items.explanation_zh: 空格後 recent fluctuations in global aluminum prices 為名詞片語，且與主句「仍將維持原報價至十二月」構成讓步對比關係；(A) Notwithstanding 為正式商務介系詞，意為「儘管（= Despite）」，後接名詞片語完全吻合。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: Provided 作條件連詞時後接完整子句，且語意非條件關係。
Consequently 為副詞「因此」，不可直接統攝名詞片語作介系詞。
Whereas 為對比從屬連接詞，後方須接具動詞之完整子句。

vocabulary.note_zh: price fluctuations 指價格波動。
honor quoted rates 指信守報價。

provenance.rights_note_zh: 全原創命題與虛構商務情境，未使用任何 ETS 官方試題、劍橋或第三方受版權保護之教材與商標。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 分詞構句（Having exceeded its quarterly sales target, the flagship store...）主動完成邏輯。

items.prompt_en: ____ its third-quarter revenue target by eighteen percent, the Ginza flagship store received the regional excellence award.

evidence.quote_en: ____ its third-quarter revenue target by eighteen percent, the Ginza flagship store received

items.explanation_zh: 句首分詞片語邏輯主詞為 the Ginza flagship store，主動達成並超越（exceed）營收目標且發生於獲獎（received）之前，又後接直接受詞 its third-quarter revenue target，故選主動完成分詞 (C) Having exceeded。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: Exceed 為原形動詞，無連接詞時不可與主句並置或形成祈使句。
Exceeded 為過去分詞表被動，無法帶直接受詞 its third-quarter revenue target。
To be exceeded 為被動不定詞，語態與受詞結構均不成立。

vocabulary.note_zh: flagship store 指品牌旗艦店。

provenance.rights_note_zh: 全原創命題與虛構商務情境，未使用任何 ETS 官方試題、劍橋或第三方受版權保護之教材與商標。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 高階商務副詞（tentatively scheduled 暫定排程）與後續待最終簽核語境呼應。

items.prompt_en: The beta release of the acoustic sensor firmware is ____ scheduled for April 14, pending final validation from the quality assurance team.

evidence.quote_en: is ____ scheduled for April 14, pending final validation from the quality assurance team

items.explanation_zh: 後半句 pending final validation from the quality assurance team（有待品保團隊最終驗證）清楚顯示四月十四日的發布日期僅為「暫定」，tentatively scheduled 為高頻商務搭配，故選 (A) tentatively。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: permanently 意為「永久地」，與後方 pending final validation（尚待最終確認）直接矛盾。
reluctantly 意為「不情願地」，不符合軟體版本排程之客觀商務語境。
mutually 意為「相互地、彼此地」，常搭配 beneficial 或 agreed，不與 pending validation 構成邏輯呼應。

vocabulary.note_zh: tentatively scheduled 指暫定排程。
pending final validation 指有待最終驗證。

provenance.rights_note_zh: 全原創命題與虛構商務情境，未使用任何 ETS 官方試題、劍橋或第三方受版權保護之教材與商標。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 精確介系詞搭配（commensurate with 與…相稱／相當）。

items.prompt_en: Portfolios managed by Aurelia Wealth Advisory are structured to generate returns commensurate ____ each client's stated risk tolerance.

evidence.quote_en: generate returns commensurate ____ each client's stated risk tolerance

items.explanation_zh: 形容詞 commensurate 意為「相稱的、相當的」，固定搭配介系詞 with（commensurate with each client's stated risk tolerance 與每位客戶聲明之風險承受度相稱），故選 (A) with。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: from 不與 commensurate 搭配。
into 表轉入或進入，不與 commensurate 搭配。
over 表高於或涵蓋，無法構成 commensurate 之慣用介系詞組。

vocabulary.note_zh: commensurate with 意為「與…相稱」。
投資理財核心術語。

provenance.rights_note_zh: 全原創命題與虛構商務情境，未使用任何 ETS 官方試題、劍橋或第三方受版權保護之教材與商標。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 假設語氣／要求動詞後 that 子句受格被動原形（stipulated that all subcontractor invoices be itemized）。

items.prompt_en: The revised procurement charter stipulates that every subcontractor invoice ____ by work-order code prior to disbursement.

evidence.quote_en: stipulates that every subcontractor invoice ____ by work-order code prior to disbursement

items.explanation_zh: 主要動詞 stipulates（明文規定、要求）後方引導之名詞子句須使用祈使假設語氣（should + 原形動詞，should 省略），且主詞 every subcontractor invoice 為被逐項列舉之對象（by work-order code），故選被動原形 (C) be itemized。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: itemizes 為第三人稱單數主動式，不符合規定子句原形假設語氣，且發票無法主動列舉。
is itemizing 為現在進行主動式，語氣與語態均錯。
was itemized 為過去簡單被動式，違反 stipulates that 後接原形動詞之語法規則。

vocabulary.note_zh: 合約條款高頻動詞。
itemize an invoice 指列明明細。
prior to disbursement 指撥款前。

provenance.rights_note_zh: 全原創命題與虛構商務情境，未使用任何 ETS 官方試題、劍橋或第三方受版權保護之教材與商標。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 句首否定副詞片語倒裝結構（Under no circumstances should laboratory samples be left...）。

items.prompt_en: Under no circumstances ____ unsealed diagnostic specimens be left unattended on the centrifuge counter.

evidence.quote_en: Under no circumstances ____ unsealed diagnostic specimens be left unattended

items.explanation_zh: 否定介系詞片語 Under no circumstances（在任何情況下皆決不…）置於句首時，主要子句須採助動詞倒裝結構（助動詞 + 主詞 unsealed diagnostic specimens + 原形被動動詞 be left），故選助動詞 (A) should。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: having 為分詞，無法與後方原形被動 be left 構成倒裝限定動詞。
whether 為連接詞，置於此處會使句子缺乏助動詞且無法搭配原形 be left。
unless 為從屬連接詞，不可搭配原形動詞 be left 且使全句無主要子句。

vocabulary.note_zh: diagnostic specimens 指診斷檢體。
leave unattended 指棄置無人看管。

provenance.rights_note_zh: 全原創命題與虛構商務情境，未使用任何 ETS 官方試題、劍橋或第三方受版權保護之教材與商標。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 涵蓋動詞時態、轉折副詞、商務字彙搭配與段落插句，考核跨句上下文連貫。

documents.title_en: MEMORANDUM: Upgrade to Keycard Elevator Access

blocks.text_en:
To: All Tenants, Crestview Commercial Tower
From: Building Management Office
Date: October 12
Subject: Transition to Smart Keycard Elevator Readers

Beginning November 1, the passenger elevators in Crestview Commercial Tower [[blank:ag-i-p6-000003-1]] with upgraded optical keycard readers on all floors. This modernization project is designed to reduce lobby congestion during morning peak hours while strengthening after-hours floor security.

Each tenant company will receive replacement smart badges for all registered staff members at no extra charge. [[blank:ag-i-p6-000003-2]] Your office administrator must submit an updated employee roster through the tenant portal by October 22 so that the badges can be encoded accurately.

Temporary visitor passes will still be issued at the ground-floor concierge desk upon presentation of a photo ID. [[blank:ag-i-p6-000003-3]], couriers making recurring daily deliveries may apply for a vendor access badge valid for the loading dock elevator. We appreciate your [[blank:ag-i-p6-000003-4]] as our technicians complete the installation over the next two weekends.

items.prompt_en: Select the best word or phrase for [[blank:ag-i-p6-000003-1]].

evidence.quote_en: Beginning November 1, the passenger elevators in Crestview Commercial Tower [[blank:ag-i-p6-000003-1]] with upgraded optical keycard readers

items.explanation_zh: 備忘錄日期為 10 月 12 日，句首 Beginning November 1 指未來生效時間，且主詞 passenger elevators 為「被配備（be equipped with）」感應讀卡機之對象，故選未來被動式 (B) will be equipped。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: equipped 為過去簡單式或分詞，與未來時間點 Beginning November 1 不合。
have equipped 為現在完成主動式，電梯無法主動配備設備。
are equipping 為現在進行主動式，語態錯誤。

vocabulary.note_zh: lobby congestion 指大廳人潮擁擠。

items.prompt_en: Select the best sentence for [[blank:ag-i-p6-000003-2]].

choices.text_en: Current magnetic-stripe cards will automatically deactivate at midnight on October 31.
The parking garage on Level B2 will remain closed for repainting all month.
Several retail shops on the plaza level have extended their weekend hours.
Elevator maintenance fees were refunded to tenants last quarter.

evidence.quote_en: Each tenant company will receive replacement smart badges for all registered staff members at no extra charge. [[blank:ag-i-p6-000003-2]] Your office administrator must submit an updated employee roster

items.explanation_zh: 前句說明各承租戶將免費獲得新式智慧識別證（replacement smart badges），後句要求辦公室管理員於 10 月 22 日前提交更新名單以利編碼；(A)「現有磁條卡將於 10 月 31 日午夜自動失效」完美銜接11月1日啟用新卡的過渡背景與申請新卡之必要性。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 地下二樓停車場重新粉刷與電梯門禁卡升級無關。
廣場層零售店延長週末營業時間偏離主題。
上季退還電梯維護費與本段申辦新門禁卡流程無邏輯關聯。

vocabulary.note_zh: 門禁卡或帳號到期停用常見動詞。

items.prompt_en: Select the best word or phrase for [[blank:ag-i-p6-000003-3]].

evidence.quote_en: Temporary visitor passes will still be issued at the ground-floor concierge desk upon presentation of a photo ID. [[blank:ag-i-p6-000003-3]], couriers making recurring daily deliveries may apply for a vendor access badge

items.explanation_zh: 前句說明一般臨時訪客可在一樓服務台換證，本句補充說明「此外，每日固定送件的快遞員可申請貨梯專用廠商通行證」，屬並列補充非員工之通行方式，故選轉折副詞片語 (A) In addition。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: Otherwise 意為「否則」，前後並非條件威脅關係。
Consequently 意為「因此」，一般訪客換證並非快遞員申請貨梯證的原因。
Instead of 為介系詞片語，不能單獨置於句首並以逗號隔開完整子句。

vocabulary.meaning_zh: 大樓服務台人員、禮賓部
vocabulary.note_zh: concierge desk 指大樓接待服務台。

items.prompt_en: Select the best word or phrase for [[blank:ag-i-p6-000003-4]].

evidence.quote_en: We appreciate your [[blank:ag-i-p6-000003-4]] as our technicians complete the installation over the next two weekends.

items.explanation_zh: 公告結尾慣用語 We appreciate your cooperation（感謝您的配合／合作），契合工程施工與換證期間請住戶配合之語境，故選 (A) cooperation。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: ambition 意為「野心、抱負」，不適用於物業管理致謝語。
obligation 意為「義務」，語氣生硬且不構成感謝搭配。
reservation 意為「預約；保留意見」，與施工期間感謝住戶配合無關。

vocabulary.note_zh: employee roster 指員工名冊。

provenance.rights_note_zh: 全原創命題與虛構商務情境，未使用任何 ETS 官方試題、劍橋或第三方受版權保護之教材與商標。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 企業客戶成功案例電子郵件，結合詞性變化、連接副詞、精準動詞與段落插句。

documents.title_en: Subject: Feature Request — Solis Logistics Case Study

blocks.text_en:
To: Nadia Khatri <nkhatri@solislogistics.com>
From: Julian Vance <jvance@routeoptima.io>
Date: September 19
Subject: Featuring Solis Logistics in Our Annual Client Spotlight

Dear Ms. Khatri,

Over the past eight months, your regional dispatch team has achieved a remarkable 22 percent reduction in fuel consumption using RouteOptima's fleet-scheduling platform. Because of these [[blank:ag-i-p6-000004-1]] results, our editorial board would like to profile Solis Logistics in our upcoming Client Spotlight report.

Participation would involve a 30-minute video interview with our communications writer next week. [[blank:ag-i-p6-000004-2]] Nothing will be published without your legal department's written sign-off.

As a token of appreciation, participating partner organizations receive two complimentary passes to our Transport Tech Summit in Chicago this November. [[blank:ag-i-p6-000004-3]], your company logo and sustainability metrics will be featured on our conference main stage.

Please let me know by Friday whether you would like to [[blank:ag-i-p6-000004-4]] with the interview.

items.prompt_en: Select the best word or phrase for [[blank:ag-i-p6-000004-1]].

evidence.quote_en: Because of these [[blank:ag-i-p6-000004-1]] results, our editorial board would like to profile Solis Logistics

items.explanation_zh: 空格位於指示形容詞 these 與名詞 results 之間，且用來形容「令人印象深刻的成果（事物性質）」，故選形容詞 (C) impressive。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: impress 為動詞，不可直接修飾名詞 results。
impressed 為情緒分詞形容詞「（人）感到印象深刻的」，不能修飾事物 results。
impressively 為副詞，不可直接修飾名詞 results。

vocabulary.note_zh: profile a company 指對企業作專題報導。

items.prompt_en: Select the best sentence for [[blank:ag-i-p6-000004-2]].

choices.text_en: We will send you the full draft article for review before it goes to layout.
The fleet-scheduling software requires a hardware reboot every Sunday night.
Tickets to the Chicago summit sold out three weeks ahead of schedule.
Our accounting office has already processed your monthly subscription invoice.

evidence.quote_en: Participation would involve a 30-minute video interview with our communications writer next week. [[blank:ag-i-p6-000004-2]] Nothing will be published without your legal department's written sign-off.

items.explanation_zh: 前句說明參與專題僅需進行 30 分鐘視訊訪談，後句保證「未經貴司法務部門書面簽核，絕不會公開發表任何內容」；(A)「我們會在排版前將完整草稿寄給您審閱」完美串聯訪談後的審稿與簽核流程。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 軟體每週日重開機之技術細節與專訪審稿流程無關。
若芝加哥峰會門票已售罄，與下一段贈送兩張免費門票矛盾且位置錯置。
月費發票入帳與案例專訪及法務簽核無關。

vocabulary.note_zh: written sign-off 指書面核准。

items.prompt_en: Select the best word or phrase for [[blank:ag-i-p6-000004-3]].

evidence.quote_en: participating partner organizations receive two complimentary passes to our Transport Tech Summit in Chicago this November. [[blank:ag-i-p6-000004-3]], your company logo and sustainability metrics will be featured on our conference main stage.

items.explanation_zh: 前句提出第一項回饋（獲贈兩張峰會免費門票），本句遞進提出第二項曝光福利（貴公司標誌與永續數據將於大會主舞台展示），故選表遞進補充之副詞 (B) Moreover。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: Nevertheless 表轉折讓步「然而」，與兩項正面福利之並列遞進關係相反。
Conversely 表「相反地」，語意不合。
For instance 表舉例，主舞台曝光並非免費門票的例子而是額外福利。

vocabulary.note_zh: complimentary passes 指免費貴賓通行證。

items.prompt_en: Select the best word or phrase for [[blank:ag-i-p6-000004-4]].

evidence.quote_en: Please let me know by Friday whether you would like to [[blank:ag-i-p6-000004-4]] with the interview.

items.explanation_zh: proceed with + 名詞 意為「繼續進行、著手辦理（該項訪談）」，為標準商務動詞搭配，故選 (A) proceed。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: precede 為形近動詞「在…之前發生」，為及物動詞且語意不合。
possess 意為「擁有」，不搭配 with the interview。
prolong 意為「延長（時間）」，為及物動詞且此處詢問是否同意進行訪談而非延長。

vocabulary.note_zh: proceed with the interview 指安排進行訪談。

provenance.rights_note_zh: 全原創命題與虛構商務情境，未使用任何 ETS 官方試題、劍橋或第三方受版權保護之教材與商標。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 單篇顧客服務公告，考核主旨與細節條件比對。

documents.title_en: Hearthstone Ceramic Studio — Custom Order & Exchange Policy

blocks.text_en:
Thank you for shopping at Hearthstone Ceramic Studio. Standard dinnerware sets purchased from our showroom shelves may be exchanged or returned for a full refund within 30 days of purchase, provided they are unused and accompanied by the original printed receipt.

Please note that custom-monogrammed platters and bespoke restaurant glaze orders require a 40 percent nonrefundable deposit at the time the order is placed. However, if any item arrives with a manufacturing crack or glaze defect, our studio will fire and ship a replacement piece at no cost if you e-mail photographs of the damage to support@hearthstoneceramics.com within 72 hours of delivery.

items.prompt_en: What is required to receive a full refund on a standard dinnerware set?

choices.text_en: Returning the unused items with the original receipt within 30 days
Paying a 40 percent restocking fee at the showroom desk
Submitting photographs of the tableware within 72 hours
Exchanging the set for a bespoke restaurant glaze order

evidence.quote_en: Standard dinnerware sets purchased from our showroom shelves may be exchanged or returned for a full refund within 30 days of purchase, provided they are unused and accompanied by the original printed receipt.

items.explanation_zh: 第一段明載：展售架上購買之標準餐具組若於購買後 30 天內退回、保持未使用且附帶原始紙本收據，即可獲得全額退費，故選 (A)。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 40% 為客製化訂單之不可退還訂金，而非標準餐具退貨手續費。
72 小時內寄送損壞照片適用於到貨有裂痕或釉面瑕疵之免費補寄申請。
文中未規定必須換購餐廳客製化釉色訂單才能退費。

vocabulary.note_zh: bespoke orders 指客製化訂單。

items.prompt_en: Under what circumstance will the studio replace a custom-monogrammed platter free of charge?

choices.text_en: When a customer decides to change the monogram spelling after firing
When the item is delivered with a structural crack and reported with photos within three days
When the order is canceled before the 30-day showroom return window expires
When the buyer visits the showroom in person without a receipt

evidence.quote_en: if any item arrives with a manufacturing crack or glaze defect, our studio will fire and ship a replacement piece at no cost if you e-mail photographs of the damage to support@hearthstoneceramics.com within 72 hours of delivery.

items.explanation_zh: 第二段指出若商品送達時有製造裂痕或釉面瑕疵（manufacturing crack or glaze defect），且於交貨後 72 小時（即三天）內寄送損壞照片至客服信箱，工坊將免費重新燒製並寄送替換品，故選 (B)。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 文中未允許燒製後免費更改客製化刻字拼寫。
客製化刻字餐盤有 40% 不可退訂金，不適用 30 天展間一般退貨條款。
需透過電子郵件寄送損壞照片，且一般退貨亦須附收據。

vocabulary.note_zh: 餐具常見詞彙。

provenance.rights_note_zh: 全原創命題與虛構商務情境，未使用任何 ETS 官方試題、劍橋或第三方受版權保護之教材與商標。

difficulty.rationale_zh: 企業內部產線調整通知，包含主旨、否定細節（NOT true）與四位置插句題。

documents.title_en: Internal Notice: Calibration Shutdown for Packaging Line B

blocks.text_en:
To: All Shift Supervisors, Brno Bottling Facility
From: Marek Horak, Director of Plant Operations
Date: November 4
Subject: Scheduled Laser-Sensor Calibration on Packaging Line B

On Thursday, November 7, Packaging Line B will be taken offline from 1:00 P.M. to 5:00 P.M. so that engineers from Viktoria Optics can calibrate the high-speed fill-level sensors. [[position:1]] Recent quality audits showed a slight variance in bottle fill volumes during peak throughput, and this preventive adjustment will ensure full compliance with European export standards. [[position:2]]

To avoid delaying our Friday shipment to Munich, afternoon bottling runs originally assigned to Line B will be rerouted to Packaging Line A and Packaging Line C. [[position:3]] Those two lines have sufficient reserve capacity to absorb the extra 14,000 units without requiring overtime hours. [[position:4]] Line B operators should report to Conference Room 2B at 1:15 P.M. on Thursday for a two-hour refresher seminar on the updated sensor diagnostic dashboard.

items.prompt_en: Why is Packaging Line B being shut down on Thursday afternoon?

choices.text_en: To adjust optical sensors that measure liquid levels in bottles
To repair a broken conveyor belt damaged during the morning shift
To reduce electricity usage during municipal power maintenance
To install a brand-new labeling machine for domestic orders

evidence.quote_en: so that engineers from Viktoria Optics can calibrate the high-speed fill-level sensors. [[position:1]] Recent quality audits showed a slight variance in bottle fill volumes

items.explanation_zh: 第一段說明 B 包裝線於週四下午停機是為了讓 Viktoria Optics 工程師校正高速液位感測器（calibrate the high-speed fill-level sensors），以解決裝瓶容量微小誤差，對應 (A)。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 文中為預防性校正液位感測器，未提及早班輸送帶斷裂。
未提及市政電力維護或節電。
目的是符合歐洲出口標準之液位感測校正，而非安裝內銷貼標機。

vocabulary.note_zh: calibrate sensors 指校準感測器。

items.prompt_en: What is indicated about Friday's shipment to Munich?

choices.text_en: It has been postponed until next Monday morning.
It will require staff to work four hours of paid overtime.
Its production volume will be handled by two other packaging lines.
It will be inspected in Conference Room 2B at 1:15 P.M.

evidence.quote_en: To avoid delaying our Friday shipment to Munich, afternoon bottling runs originally assigned to Line B will be rerouted to Packaging Line A and Packaging Line C.

items.explanation_zh: 第二段指出，為避免延誤週五運往慕尼黑的貨件，原定於 B 線進行的下午裝瓶批次將改道由 A 線與 C 線處理，且不需加班即可吸收 14,000 瓶產量，故選 (C)。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 文中明確表示採取分流措施以避免延誤（To avoid delaying），並未延後。
文中明言 without requiring overtime hours（無須加班）。
2B 會議室是供 B 線操作員參加感測器診斷儀表板複訓研討會之地點。

vocabulary.note_zh: reroute production runs 指將生產批次轉移至其他產線。

items.prompt_en:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"No products have failed safety standards, but fine-tuning the equipment now will prevent costly rejects later."

evidence.quote_en: Recent quality audits showed a slight variance in bottle fill volumes during peak throughput, and this preventive adjustment will ensure full compliance with European export standards. [[position:2]]

items.explanation_zh: 待插入句「目前並無任何產品未達安全標準，但現在微調設備能避免日後產生高昂的不良品報廢成本」承接前句「近期品質稽核發現尖峰產能時裝瓶量有微小變異，此預防性調整將確保完全符合歐洲出口標準」，補充說明該變異尚未造成不合格但需預防性微調，置於 [[position:2]] 邏輯最緊密。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 置於 [1] 時尚未提及 quality audits 與 slight variance，突然說 No products have failed 缺乏前文背景。
[3] 前後正在說明將 14,000 瓶產能分流至 A 線與 C 線，插入品管微調理由會打斷產能調度連貫性。
[4] 後方接操作員教育訓練安排，與不良品報廢無直接銜接。

vocabulary.note_zh: fill volume variance 指充填容量差異。

provenance.rights_note_zh: 全原創命題與虛構商務情境，未使用任何 ETS 官方試題、劍橋或第三方受版權保護之教材與商標。
